teaser.en: It looks like a palm but belongs to a plant line older than the dinosaurs, and its seeds once fed people in famine.
teaser.sw: Unafanana na mmea wa jamii ya mnazi, lakini ni wa ukoo wa mimea wa zamani kuliko dinosaria, na mbegu zake ziliwahi kuwalisha watu wakati wa njaa.

summary.en: *Mtsapu* is Hildebrandt's cycad, a palm-like plant with a stout trunk and a crown of stiff, spiny leaves. It was a famine food and a weaving plant, and it is now rare and protected from illegal collectors.
summary.sw: *Mtsapu* ni msapo (Hildebrandt's cycad), mmea unaofanana na mnazi wenye shina nene na taji la majani magumu yenye miiba. Ulikuwa chakula cha wakati wa njaa na mmea wa kusuka, na sasa ni adimu na unalindwa dhidi ya wakusanyaji haramu.

about.en: *Mtsapu* looks like a small palm: a stout, unbranched trunk up to 6 m tall, topped with a crown of arching, stiff leaves whose leaflets have spiny teeth. It is not a palm at all but a cycad, from an ancient group of seed plants that bear cones instead of flowers. Its cones are large and heavy, and male and female cones grow on separate plants.
about.sw: *Mtsapu* unafanana na mmea mdogo wa jamii ya mnazi: shina nene lisilo na matawi, lenye urefu wa hadi m 6, likiwa na taji la majani magumu yaliyopinda ambayo vijani vyake vina meno ya miiba. Kwa kweli si wa jamii ya mnazi hata kidogo bali ni *cycad*, kutoka kundi la kale la mimea yenye mbegu ambayo huzaa koni badala ya maua. Koni zake ni kubwa na nzito, na koni za kiume na za kike hukua kwenye mimea tofauti.

where.en: It grows in coastal evergreen bushland and lowland forest, in a few places along the coast.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyika ya vichaka ya pwani isiyopukutika majani na katika misitu ya nyanda za chini, sehemu chache kando ya pwani.

uses.en: The soft centre of the stem was eaten. In times of famine, the seeds were boiled and ground into flour, though this is now reputed to be harmful. The leaves are used for thatch and for weaving, and *chitsapu* is counted among Digo weaving plants. The cones have ceremonial uses.
uses.sw: Kiini laini cha shina kililiwa. Nyakati za njaa, mbegu zilichemshwa na kusagwa kuwa unga, ingawa sasa inasemekana kuwa unga huo ni hatari. Majani hutumika kuezekea na kusuka, na *chitsapu* huhesabiwa miongoni mwa mimea ya kusuka ya Wadigo. Koni zake hutumika katika sherehe za kimila.

culture.en: Its role as a famine food made it a plant people remembered in hard times. The cones are also used in ceremonies.
culture.sw: Kwa kuwa kilikuwa chakula cha wakati wa njaa, ulikuwa mmea ambao watu waliukumbuka nyakati ngumu. Koni zake pia hutumika katika sherehe za kimila.

names.en: Pakia records *mtsapu*, and also *chitsapu*; in Giriama it is *kitsapu*. Swahili names are *msapo*, *mkwanga* and *mgwende*. In English it is Hildebrandt's cycad.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi *mtsapu*, na pia *chitsapu*; kwa Kigiriama ni *kitsapu*. Majina ya Kiswahili ni *msapo*, *mkwanga* na *mgwende*. Kwa Kiingereza ni *Hildebrandt's cycad*.

conservation.en: *Mtsapu* is rare and is collected illegally as an ornamental plant, which removes whole plants from the wild. Cycads grow slowly, so losses are hard to replace.
conservation.sw: *Mtsapu* ni adimu na hukusanywa kinyume cha sheria kama mmea wa mapambo, jambo linaloondoa mimea mizima porini. Mimea ya aina ya *cycad* hukua polepole, kwa hiyo hasara hizi ni vigumu kufidiwa.

reason.en: Rabai screw pine, another palm-like forest plant used for weaving
reason.sw: Msanaka, mmea mwingine wa msituni unaofanana na mnazi na unaotumika kusuka

reason.en: Doum palm, a weaving plant of the coast
reason.sw: Mkoma, mmea wa kusuka wa pwani

reason.en: Wild date palm, similar palm-like look
reason.sw: Mkindu, wenye sura inayofanana na mnazi

reason.en: Polynesian arrowroot, another plant made into flour
reason.sw: Ulanga, mmea mwingine unaosagwa kuwa unga
